recent_excerpts: Poland's ABW found NSO Group retained exclusive control of Pegasus servers, giving it technical access to surveillance data on 500+ targets, prosecutors say.
Bitdefender found Midnight Mimosa ad-fraud malware preinstalled on thousands of MediaTek-based Android phones across 150+ countries, with 32 disguised payload apps.
Google's September Pixel bulletin patches CVE-2026-58704, a high-severity modem privilege-escalation flaw under limited, targeted exploitation, plus 109 other bugs.
